help.goal: Make people say the word on your phone without saying it yourself. Most words explained wins.
steps: Hand the phone to the explainer and tap Start the round.
Explain the word on screen without saying it or its parts.
Tap Got it ✓ the moment someone shouts the word.
Tap Skip ↷ to dump a word you cannot explain.
At zero, pass the phone on and start the next round.
notes: Teams mode: 🔴 and 🔵 share one phone, and only the explainer's team may guess.
Party mode: everyone plays on their own phone for their own score.
Taps after the clock hits zero score nothing, so the buzzer is final.
